name: camofox-mcp
description: Anti-detection browser automation MCP server for AI agents. Exposes up to 57 tools through configurable core, semantic, and legacy layers.

environment_variables.name: CAMOFOX_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional API key for CamoFox Browser authentication

environment_variables.name: CAMOFOX_TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: MCP transport mode: stdio or http

environment_variables.name: CAMOFOX_HTTP_PORT
environment_variables.description: HTTP server port for streamable HTTP transport

environment_variables.name: CAMOFOX_PROFILE
environment_variables.description: Tool profile: full, lean, or custom

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Check browser-server health, connection state, and active tab count.

tools.name: stop_browser
tools.description: Gracefully shut down the CamoFox browser server.

tools.name: create_tab
tools.description: Create and track a new anti-detection browser tab.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tracked browser tab and optionally auto-save its profile.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List tracked browser tabs.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a tab to a URL.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Navigate backward in browser history.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in browser history.

tools.name: refresh
tools.description: Reload the current tab.

tools.name: import_cookies
tools.description: Import cookies into a user session or tab.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Return tab and browser-server statistics.

tools.name: camofox_close_session
tools.description: Close all tracked tabs for a logical user session.

tools.name: toggle_display
tools.description: Switch a user session between headless, headed, and virtual display modes.

tools.name: set_task_context
tools.description: Set task context for a tracked tab.

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Get task context for a tracked tab.

tools.name: diagnose_failure
tools.description: Diagnose a failed browser task with tracked context.

tools.name: save_profile
tools.description: Save the current tab cookies to a named profile.

tools.name: load_profile
tools.description: Load a saved cookie profile into a tab.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List saved profiles.

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a saved profile.

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: List downloads with filters.

tools.name: get_download
tools.description: Return download metadata and optional inline content.

tools.name: delete_download
tools.description: Delete a download from disk and registry.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from a page with an LLM-assisted workflow.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Rank relevant interactive elements for an intent.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Plan and optionally execute a natural-language browser action.

tools.name: find_element_by_prompt
tools.description: Resolve an element ref or selector from a natural-language prompt.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run a typed deterministic action plan.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by snapshot ref or CSS selector.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into an input by ref or selector.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page.

tools.name: camofox_scroll_element
tools.description: Scroll a specific container element.

tools.name: camofox_evaluate_js
tools.description: Execute isolated JavaScript in the page context.

tools.name: camofox_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element.

tools.name: camofox_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for page readiness and optional network idle.

tools.name: camofox_press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Return an accessibility-tree snapshot with refs.

tools.name: snapshot_dialog
tools.description: Return a focused dialog snapshot.

tools.name: camofox_get_page_html
tools.description: Return rendered page HTML or selected element HTML.

tools.name: camofox_query_selector
tools.description: Inspect a CSS selector and optional attribute.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Extract links from a page or scoped container.

tools.name: camofox_wait_for_text
tools.description: Wait for text to appear.

tools.name: camofox_wait_for_selector
tools.description: Wait for a selector to appear.

tools.name: smart_snapshot
tools.description: Return an LLM-summarized compact page state.

tools.name: extract_resources
tools.description: Extract images, links, media, or documents from a DOM scope.

tools.name: batch_download
tools.description: Extract and download matching resources in one workflow.

tools.name: resolve_blobs
tools.description: Resolve blob URLs to downloadable data.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Run a built-in search workflow.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Fetch a YouTube transcript without opening a tab.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple fields and optionally submit.

tools.name: type_and_submit
tools.description: Type into one field and press a key.

tools.name: navigate_and_snapshot
tools.description: Navigate and return a snapshot.

tools.name: scroll_and_snapshot
tools.description: Scroll and return a snapshot.

tools.name: camofox_scroll_element_and_snapshot
tools.description: Scroll a container and return a snapshot.

tools.name: batch_click
tools.description: Click multiple targets and report per-click results.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List CamoFox geo presets.
